name: Crystal Canyon Temple
description: A hidden canyon carved entirely from massive crystal formations, housing a ancient temple whose walls reflect shifting constellations and glow with inner light.
prompt: Stunning canyon lined with towering crystal formations, an ancient temple nestled within, walls shimmering with reflected stars, soft ambient glow, dramatic lighting, hyperrealistic, no text, sense of timeless reverence.
caption: Step into a canyon of glass where the night sky lives within the walls—ancient stone meets eternal starlight.
